explorations.title: Equally likely outcomes
explorations.instruction: Predict: what will change in the entropy readout when all active outcomes have equal raw weight? Then apply the preset, which sets n to 3, w1 to 1, w2 to 1, w3 to 1, and w4 to 0.
explorations.observe: The normalized probabilities become about 0.333 each, each contribution becomes about 0.528 bits, max_entropy becomes 1.585 bits, and total entropy becomes 1.585 bits.
explorations.why: With n equally likely outcomes, each probability is 1/n, so each contribution is (1/n) log2 n and the sum is log2 n, the maximum possible entropy for n outcomes.

explorations.title: Certain outcome
explorations.instruction: Predict: what happens to entropy when one outcome has all the raw weight and the others have zero? Then apply the preset, which sets n to 3, w1 to 5, w2 to 0, w3 to 0, and w4 to 0.
explorations.observe: The normalized probabilities become 1 for outcome 1 and 0 elsewhere, all contributions become 0 bits, max_entropy stays 1.585 bits, and total entropy becomes 0 bits.
explorations.why: A certain outcome carries no uncertainty, so H is 0. Zero probabilities contribute 0 because the limit of p_i log2 p_i as p_i approaches 0 is 0, not undefined.
